sn4.22:2.2: “Here, venerable sir, I was meditating not far from the Buddha, diligent, keen, and resolute.
sn4.22:2.3: While I was in private retreat, venerable sir, this thought came to my mind:
sn4.22:2.7: that I have gone forth in a teaching and training so well explained!
sn4.22:2.9: that I have spiritual companions who are ethical and of good character.”
sn4.22:2.10: Then close to me, venerable sir, there was a great, frightening, terrible noise, and it seemed as if the earth was shattering.”
